Landing.metaDescription: Enterprise-ready fullstack monorepo boilerplate built with Next.js 15 App Router, NestJS, TailwindCSS v4, TypeORM, and TanStack Query.

hero.title: Modern Enterprise Full-Stack Architecture
hero.subtitle: Production-ready monorepo template featuring Next.js 15 App Router, NestJS API, TypeORM PostgreSQL, TailwindCSS v4, TanStack Query, and robust authentication.

techStack.title: Industry-Standard Technologies
techStack.subtitle: Every library and tool is carefully picked for performance, developer velocity, and maintainability.

features.title: Everything you need to ship faster
features.subtitle: Clean architecture patterns, modular boundaries, and scalable design built directly into the core.

monorepo.title: Turborepo & pnpm Workspace
monorepo.description: High-performance monorepo orchestration with remote caching, unified lockfile, and shared configuration packages.

auth.title: Smart Auth & Dynamic Route Guards
auth.description: Zero-config folder-based route protection with App Router Route Groups, proactive HTTP-only token refresh, Google OAuth, and graceful session-expired alerts.

forms.title: Strict Form Validation
forms.description: Type-safe forms using React Hook Form coupled with Zod schemas and Sonner toast notifications.

query.title: TanStack React Query
query.description: Client-side query caching, background prefetching, optimistic mutations, and automated cache invalidation.

i18n.title: Full Internationalization
i18n.description: Built-in next-intl routing for multi-language support (English & Vietnamese) with zero layout shift.

design.title: TailwindCSS v4 & Radix UI
design.description: Composable, accessible UI primitives with responsive layouts, dark/light theme switching, and smooth animations.

portal.title: Turnkey Enterprise Administration
portal.subtitle: Ship with a dedicated Vite + React admin dashboard ready out-of-the-box. Manage users, permissions, audit trails, and branding without building from scratch.

users.title: User & Admin Management
users.description: Full lifecycle administration with email verification status, profile edits, and multi-admin hierarchy.

rbac.title: CASL Role-Based Authorization
rbac.description: Granular permission matrices and dynamic ability checks for secure operations across resources.

whiteLabel.title: White-Label Brand Engine
whiteLabel.description: Multi-tenant logos, favicons, meta tags, and color schemes configured dynamically per environment.

audit.title: Audit Logs & System Health
audit.description: Real-time activity logs, mail delivery status, and system event tracking for enterprise compliance.

cta.title: Ready to kickstart your next enterprise project?
cta.subtitle: Clone the repository, customize your domain models, and deploy with confidence in minutes.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our billing and plans.

item1.question: Can I change my plan or cancel at any time?
item1.answer: Yes, you can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription anytime directly from your profile billing portal. Your changes take effect immediately.

item2.question: What payment methods are supported?
item2.answer: We support all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), Apple Pay, and Google Pay through Polar.

item3.question: How does the annual billing discount work?
item3.answer: When you choose the yearly billing cycle, you receive a 20% discount compared to the monthly plan. You are billed once a year.

item4.question: Do you offer invoices and receipts?
item4.answer: Yes, an automated invoice and receipt is generated for every payment and can be downloaded anytime from your customer portal.
